cachePolicy: Default browser cache. No route interception, no cache disable, no synthetic signed cookies. Replay contexts receive exact cookies acquired by actual credential sign-in.
scopeLimits: Supplement only: valid verify-password inputs, one previously unexecuted unconfigured social sign-in branch, and actual visible inventory Refresh after authority changes. Original116 auth groups are separate.
No item form or other business write is submitted.
Ordinary native browser behavior is retained; no BFCache restoration is forced.

browserCacheConfiguration.claim: Native BFCache is permitted but eligibility and use depend on actual Chromium/application behavior. History traversal alone does not prove a BFCache hit.

secretHandling.policy: Only verified STOCKFLOW_LOCALE en/fr is excluded. All other cookie values, fixture passwords and returned session tokens remain sensitive. Recursive redaction precedes an unchanged final raw-value leak scan.
